text: Tasks now open their own screen where you can write a document, log a call, upload a file, and record what happened, without leaving the task.

Freehold now shows what each file actually costs: time is recorded automatically while a file is open, and Today charts time against fee, your most time-consuming clients, and your most efficient ones.
Scheduled emails sent from your own inbox now show up on the file right away, and replies to them thread back automatically once they go out.
